gargoyle1.text: Stone eyes watch. They've seen every soul that entered. None that left.

gargoyle2.text: Carved in judgment. The scales it holds are empty. What did they measure?

gargoyle3.text: Its mouth is open in a silent scream. Or perhaps a warning.

messages: It's locked. Figures. I wonder if there is a key around here?
Still locked... maybe I should look around more.
I need to find that key to get out of here.
This looks like it's been left out here for a long time.
I wonder what's inside it.
The door is rusted shut - I'd need a crowbar or something to open it.
Whatever's in here is staying in here.
Probably just more junk anyway.
An old gas tank. Probably empty by now.
I hope this thing isn't leaking. The smell is bad enough already.
Rusted through in places. Best not to touch it.
Why would anyone leave this out here?
Heavy. Not going anywhere without help.
A child's slide. Out here in the middle of nowhere.
The paint is peeling off. How long has this been here?
I don't think anyone's played on this in years.
Something about this feels... wrong.
Rusty and weathered. Like everything else in this place.
An old wheelbarrow. The wheel's frozen solid.
Dirt caked on the inside. Wonder what it was used for.
This hasn't moved in ages.
Probably belonged to whoever farmed this land. Before.
Rusted metal and rotted wood. Nothing useful here.
An old electrical transformer. Looks ancient.
I can still hear a faint hum. Is it still on?
Hazard warnings are faded but still visible. I'll keep my distance.
This thing's ancient. Surprised it's still standing.
Better not touch it. Even dead, these things can be dangerous.
A stone well. Deep and dark.
I can't see the bottom. Maybe that's for the best.
Something about this well makes my skin crawl.
If I dropped something down there, I'd never get it back.
The stones are slick with moss and age.
An old tree. Its branches reach out like skeletal fingers.
The bark is rough and weathered.
I can hear something rustling in the branches above.
Trees like this have seen everything. And remember nothing.
Gnarled and twisted. Like it's been here forever.
A broken mirror. The cracks distort my reflection.
Seven years bad luck? I think I'm already there.
I can see myself... but something looks off.
The shards catch the light in unsettling ways.
Better not to look too closely.
A crude altar. What were they worshipping out here?
Dark stains mark the stone surface.
This wasn't built for any god I know.
The air feels colder near this thing.
Some rituals are better left forgotten.
An old brazier. Cold ashes fill the bowl.
Whatever burned here last did so long ago.
I could light this... but should I?
The metal is blackened from countless fires.
Something about this feels ceremonial.
An old tree stump. Cut down years ago.
The rings tell a story of seasons long past.
I could rest here for a moment. But I won't.
Moss and decay have claimed what's left.
A natural seat in this unnatural place.
A toilet sitting out in the open. That's... unsettling.
Porcelain stained with age and neglect.
Why would anyone put this here?
Some things are better left unused.
The seat is cracked and filthy. I'll pass.
An old lamp. The bulb is missing.
It must have lit this path once. Before the darkness came.
Rust has eaten through the metal in places.
A porta-potty. Out here? That's bizarre.
The door hangs slightly ajar. I'm not looking inside.
The plastic is faded and cracked from years of exposure.
I can smell it from here. Definitely not going in.
Who would use this in a place like this? Who would BRING this here?
A stone gargoyle. Its eyes seem to follow me.
Weathered by time, but still watching. Always watching.
The craftsmanship is crude, but effective. It unnerves me.
I feel judged by those hollow eyes.
Silent sentinels of this cursed place.
